notes.title: CameraRig Crane during the creation of a cinematic
notes.notes:
Initially, I used the CameraRig Crane during the creation of a cinematic. I added a camera, animated it, and configured the loading of a previously saved castle. During the process, it turned out that you can play the game during the camera's flight! Profit!

notes.title: Exciting update in #PerfectCastle!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=qmveC_L5wCg;full][/previewyoutube]
Continuing the development of "Perfect Castle", I've added a new camera rotation option. Besides the standard rotation around the active figure controlled by the mouse, which is quite flexible but can be a bit complex at first, I've now introduced a simpler method.

This new addition allows for camera rotation around the entire castle, taking average and minimum values across axes. It offers a less flexible but more reliable and stable camera movement.
